profile_text.body:
Synopsys Inc is a public company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, trading under the ticker SNPS. Its website describes it as a provider of EDA tools, semiconductor IP and systems verification, and says it delivers "silicon-to-systems solutions that help innovators accelerate development, reduce risk, and drive breakthroughs." The site also carries a notice that visitors may interact with an AI-powered chatbot offering general information about Synopsys and its products and services, which the notice states may be incorrect or incomplete and is superseded by applicable agreements.

The site highlights work on AI and multi-die designs, including an item titled "Synopsys Advances Power and Performance for AI and Multi-Die Designs on Latest Samsung Foundry Processes at SAFE Forum 2026."

Its litigation record includes 281 cases in California. No products or MCP servers are tracked for the company.
